summary: Keep Immich personal-library workflows statically discoverable and conservative: command wiring matches runtime help, unknown duplicate keepers require review, and partial uploads or malformed source collections remain visible.
reason: The extension hook hid valid command edges from the shipped verifier, while review found three workflow safety gaps: inferred duplicate keepers, lost IDs after metadata failure, and ignored collection decode errors.
validated_outcome: verify_skill.py --strict resolves the novel command paths; focused regression tests cover explicit duplicate keeper review, retained upload IDs, and malformed source collections.
